title: DanceFitness
description: A dance fitness web app with class schedules, instructor profiles and booking system. Built with a modern stack for seamless UX.
longDescription: A full-featured dance fitness platform featuring weekly class schedules, instructor profiles, an online booking system, and a responsive gallery. Designed for a local fitness studio.

title: UgráLóVár Jászberény
description: Bounce castle rental website for Jászberény — built for a local business. Features online booking, gallery, and pricing info.
longDescription: A complete business website for a local bounce castle rental company. Includes an interactive castle gallery, online booking request form, pricing tables, and a fun animated landing page.

title: DevBlog HU
description: A personal developer blog with MDX support, dark mode, and syntax highlighting. Written in Hungarian and English.
longDescription: A minimal but feature-rich developer blog supporting MDX, code syntax highlighting, tag filtering, RSS feed, and bilingual content (HU/EN).

title: TaskFlow
description: A Kanban-style task manager with drag-and-drop, real-time updates and team collaboration features.
longDescription: A collaborative Kanban board app with drag-and-drop card management, real-time updates via WebSockets, user auth, and team workspaces.
